## Context
A local auth service now handles GitHub browser OAuth callbacks via `auth.hack.gy` and localhost fallback. We need to keep this as a stable integration entrypoint for additional providers.

## Goals
- Define provider callback contract for auth server routes
- Add provider registration surface (`/v1/auth/providers` already present) with typed status payloads
- Document callback security model and host/routing requirements

## Notes
- Keep daemon-owned auth service lightweight
- Prefer keychain/secret-ref storage for provider secrets and tokens

## Links
- src/daemon/routes/auth.ts
- src/daemon/server.ts
- src/templates.ts
- docs/extensions.md
payload.title: Generalize local auth server for provider callbacks

## Context
The macOS GitHub extension now uses browser-first OAuth via local auth server callbacks, but users still need to configure OAuth client id + client secret storage out-of-band.

## Goals
- Add in-app GitHub OAuth app credential configuration (client id + keychain secret write)
- Validate credentials before starting browser flow
- Show actionable setup guidance when config is missing

## Notes
- Keep secret storage keychain-backed (no plain-text config values)
- Keep multi-profile account list UX unchanged

- apps/macos/Packages/Features/DashboardFeature/Sources/DashboardFeature/SettingsOverlayView.swift
- src/daemon/routes/auth.ts

## Context
We introduced workspace structure (`services/*`, `packages/*`) and added a compatibility `packages/cli` wrapper entrypoint. The physical CLI source tree still lives under `/src` and root scripts/CI/release pipelines still assume root entrypoints.

## Goals
- Move `/src` to `/packages/cli/src` with no behavior regressions.
- Update root scripts to delegate to `bun --cwd packages/cli ...` where appropriate.
- Update CI/release scripts to resolve version/build metadata from the CLI package path.
- Keep root-level compatibility wrappers for one release cycle, then remove.

## Notes
- Current compatibility stage documented in `docs/monorepo-layout-plan.md`.
- Must verify `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, macOS build/test, and release scripts after migration.

## Links
- docs/monorepo-layout-plan.md

## Context
A local auth broker package exists (`services/auth-broker`), and callback UX expects browser-based OAuth completion. We need a deployable cloud path for shared callback handling (`auth.hack.gy`) while keeping token custody local where possible.

## Goals
- Deploy `services/auth-broker` to Railway project `hack`.
- Configure callback routing and environment for GitHub app OAuth.
- Define secure token relay/claim contract so long-lived secrets remain local.

## Notes
- Include operational runbook for rotating GitHub client secrets.
- Add health checks and minimal audit logging.

## Links
- services/auth-broker/README.md

## Context
Auth broker now has Better Auth scaffolding and DB package foundation. We still need production-grade migration from ad-hoc token flow to Better Auth as the primary model for identities, sessions, organizations, and teams.

## Goals
- Promote Better Auth routes to first-class auth surface in desktop/CLI.
- Generate and apply Better Auth schema migrations on Neon.
- Implement account/org/team lifecycle UX in macOS app.
- Keep GitHub App/OAuth integration as provider features mapped to Better Auth users/orgs.

## Notes
- `services/auth-broker/src/better-auth.ts` currently enables org + teams plugin with defaults.
- Requires `DATABASE_URL` and `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` runtime config.

## Links
- services/auth-broker/src/better-auth.ts
- services/auth-broker/README.md
- packages/db/README.md

## Context
Local semantic-release validation currently fails under Node 23 (`semantic-release` requires Node >=24.10 in our dependency set). CI uses Node 24, so release config is valid in pipeline but not easy to verify locally.

## Goals
- Add a deterministic local release dry-run command that always executes with Node 24.
- Document local release validation steps for monorepo users.
- Ensure dry-run validates `.releaserc.json` + workspace version sync script behavior before real release.

## Notes
- Candidate paths: enforce Node 24 via mise/asdf wrapper, or add a dedicated script that shells into the CI-like runtime.
- Keep Bun as primary package manager; only pin Node runtime where semantic-release requires it.

## Links
- .github/workflows/release-prepare.yml
- .releaserc.json
- scripts/prepare-release.ts

## Context
The auth-broker now uses composable Elysia plugins for core, provider, and GitHub callback/start/flow routes with a root method guard. Route success/error payloads are mostly consistent, but not-found handling is still framework-default and not explicitly versioned.

## Goals
- Add an explicit auth-broker not-found envelope for API routes (`/v1/auth/*`, `/gh/*`) with deterministic JSON payloads.
- Keep HTML callback UX for browser-facing callback pages while preserving API error consistency.
- Add tests for unknown API routes and unsupported methods across the route surface.

## Notes
- Keep Better Auth passthrough behavior unchanged for `/api/auth/*`.
- Align envelope style with daemon auth route handler where possible.

## Links
- services/auth-broker/src/app.ts
- services/auth-broker/src/modules/github-oauth/plugin.ts
- services/auth-broker/tests/index.test.ts

payload.body:
## Context
GitHub OAuth callback now resolves user identity email and can link/provision Better Auth user rows.

## Remaining gap
We currently resolve and return `betterAuthUserId` hints in flow status, but we do not persist a canonical provider linkage row in Better Auth `account` for callbacks that only pass through broker OAuth.

## Why this matters
- Deterministic re-link on future callbacks
- Better auditability of provider identity ownership
- Cleaner handoff to session issuance

## Proposed follow-up
1. Add explicit GitHub account link upsert path (providerId=github/accountId=userId).
2. Add idempotent conflict strategy.
3. Add tests for existing-link, new-link, conflict, and missing-email paths.
4. Document migration/rollout notes.
payload.title: Auth broker: persist GitHub->BetterAuth account linkage
